svg.title: General Fund funding, spending and annual debt payments, FY2025 to FY2039
svg.desc: Cumulative surplus / (shortfall) above the years. Net spending rises from $15.7 million to $41.0 million; funding rises from $18.8 million to $22.2 million. Debt payments are included in spending. A through E identify five future loans. A and B first pay in FY29, C in FY30, and D and E in FY33.
